protocol.interleaved: implementations of a case alternate call by call
protocol.clock: core GHz sampled on the same thread (5 ms dependent add-reg-reg chain, 1 cycle/add) before, every 5 rounds and after each case; per-cycle rates use the median
protocol.stream: float32 arrays of max(4x LLC, 64 MiB) each, same warm-up/reps/clock protocol as the kernels, single thread on the pinned core: read = sum of one array read as 2, 4 and 8 parts side by side (interleaved), 4 bytes per element; stream_read_gbs is the fastest of the three (the roof for read-only kernels such as GEMV); triad a = b + s*c, 12 bytes per element (STREAM convention, no write-allocate; stream_triad_gbs). *_allcore_gbs: OpenMP builds with more than one usable CPU only, else null
protocol.gemv: y = x·Wᵀ, one row x, W [N, K]; gb_per_s = (weights + x + y bytes) / median time; pct_stream_read / pct_stream_triad = gb_per_s / machine.stream_read_gbs / stream_triad_gbs; weights rotate: ceil(2 x LLC / weight bytes) copies (weight_copies, at least 1), the next copy on every call of any implementation, so no call finds its weights in the last-level cache
